scope: Compare supplied flexural-strength results under three stated calibration assumptions. The conclusion is limited to these scenarios and does not estimate frequency or confidence.
prediction_prompt: Before revealing which scenarios meet the decision threshold, predict whether the claim survives every supplied calibration assumption.
expected_source_inputs: A public scene objective asking about conclusion robustness
At least two stated assumptions with captured finite metric values
A documented decision threshold and an independently checked set of supporting scenarios

independent_checks.description: A supplied scenario supports the claim exactly when its captured flexural strength is at least 50.0 MPa.
Starting from 52.0 MPa, the supplied offsets of -3.5 and -1.8 MPa give 48.5 and 50.2 MPa.
The result is limited to the three supplied calibration scenarios.
All scenario values are supplied synthetic results; no analysis runs in the browser.

source.title: Synthetic flexural-strength sensitivity record
source.statement: The nominal synthetic result is 52.0 MPa. Hypothetical calibration alternatives apply supplied offsets of -3.5 MPa and -1.8 MPa, giving captured results of 48.5 MPa and 50.2 MPa.

scenarios.label: Nominal calibration
scenarios.assumption: Use the nominal instrument calibration supplied with the fixture.

scenarios.label: Conservative calibration
scenarios.assumption: Apply the hypothetical -3.5 MPa calibration offset to the nominal result.

scenarios.label: Alternate calibration
scenarios.assumption: Apply the hypothetical -1.8 MPa calibration offset to the nominal result.

decision.claim: The specimen meets the supplied 50.0 MPa teaching threshold.
